questions.question: Consider human reaction-like events (species includes Homo sapiens) whose rank-0 input is a Complex. For how many such events is at least one of the event's own catalyst-activity physical entities also a part of that same rank-0 input complex, where 'part of' means reachable from the complex by following hasComponent links out of complexes and hasMember links out of entity sets, to any depth?

queries.sql: WITH RECURSIVE r0 AS (SELECT i.DB_ID AS ev, i.input AS cx FROM ReactionlikeEvent_2_input i JOIN Complex c ON c.DB_ID = i.input JOIN Event_2_species es ON es.DB_ID = i.DB_ID JOIN DatabaseObject sp ON sp.DB_ID = es.species AND sp._displayName = 'Homo sapiens' WHERE i.input_rank = 0), parts AS (SELECT r0.ev, hc.hasComponent AS ent FROM r0 JOIN Complex_2_hasComponent hc ON hc.DB_ID = r0.cx UNION SELECT p.ev, hc.hasComponent FROM parts p JOIN Complex_2_hasComponent hc ON hc.DB_ID = p.ent UNION SELECT p.ev, hm.hasMember FROM parts p JOIN EntitySet_2_hasMember hm ON hm.DB_ID = p.ent) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT rc.DB_ID) FROM ReactionlikeEvent_2_catalystActivity rc JOIN CatalystActivity ca ON ca.DB_ID = rc.catalystActivity JOIN parts p ON p.ev = rc.DB_ID AND p.ent = ca.physicalEntity;

questions.question: Take every event in the hasEvent hierarchy at any depth below the pathway with stable identifier R-HSA-168256. Among the EntityWithAccessionedSequence instances that are direct inputs of those events, count the distinct reference entities that are reference gene products (ReferenceGeneProduct or any subclass) and that are never the reference entity of any EntityWithAccessionedSequence appearing as a direct output of any event in that same hierarchy.

queries.sql: WITH RECURSIVE sub AS (SELECT he.hasEvent AS ev FROM DatabaseObject d JOIN StableIdentifier s ON s.DB_ID = d.stableIdentifier JOIN Pathway_2_hasEvent he ON he.DB_ID = d.DB_ID WHERE s.identifier = 'R-HSA-168256' UNION SELECT he.hasEvent FROM sub JOIN Pathway_2_hasEvent he ON he.DB_ID = sub.ev), ins AS (SELECT DISTINCT e.referenceEntity AS re FROM sub JOIN ReactionlikeEvent_2_input i ON i.DB_ID = sub.ev JOIN EntityWithAccessionedSequence e ON e.DB_ID = i.input), outs AS (SELECT DISTINCT e.referenceEntity AS re FROM sub JOIN ReactionlikeEvent_2_output o ON o.DB_ID = sub.ev JOIN EntityWithAccessionedSequence e ON e.DB_ID = o.output) SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ins JOIN ReferenceGeneProduct rgp ON rgp.DB_ID = ins.re WHERE ins.re NOT IN (SELECT re FROM outs);

questions.question: Restrict to human reaction-like events (species includes Homo sapiens) that have at least 4 distinct input entities, ignoring rank and ignoring any entity listed more than once. How many unordered pairs of two different such events have exactly the same set of input entities?

queries.sql: WITH inp AS (SELECT DISTINCT i.DB_ID AS ev, i.input AS ent FROM ReactionlikeEvent_2_input i JOIN Event_2_species es ON es.DB_ID = i.DB_ID JOIN DatabaseObject sp ON sp.DB_ID = es.species AND sp._displayName = 'Homo sapiens'), card AS (SELECT ev, COUNT(*) AS n FROM inp GROUP BY ev HAVING COUNT(*) >= 4) SELECT COUNT(*) FROM card a JOIN card b ON b.n = a.n AND b.ev > a.ev WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inp x WHERE x.ev = a.ev AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inp y WHERE y.ev = b.ev AND y.ent = x.ent));

questions.question: Consider every GO cellular component that is used as a compartment by at least one reaction-like event. How many of them reach the GO cellular component with accession 0016020 by following one or more instanceOf links?

queries.sql: WITH RECURSIVE anc AS (SELECT DISTINCT rc.compartment AS node, rc.compartment AS root FROM ReactionlikeEvent_2_compartment rc UNION SELECT i.instanceOf, a.root FROM anc a JOIN GO_CellularComponent_2_instanceOf i ON i.DB_ID = a.node) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.root) FROM anc a JOIN GO_CellularComponent g ON g.DB_ID = a.node AND g.accession = '0016020';

questions.question: Call a compartment 'membrane-derived' if it reaches the GO cellular component with accession 0016020 by following one or more instanceOf links. How many human reaction-like events (species includes Homo sapiens) are assigned at least two distinct membrane-derived compartments?

queries.sql: WITH RECURSIVE anc AS (SELECT DISTINCT rc.compartment AS node, rc.compartment AS root FROM ReactionlikeEvent_2_compartment rc UNION SELECT i.instanceOf, a.root FROM anc a JOIN GO_CellularComponent_2_instanceOf i ON i.DB_ID = a.node), memb AS (SELECT DISTINCT a.root AS cmp FROM anc a JOIN GO_CellularComponent g ON g.DB_ID = a.node AND g.accession = '0016020') SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT rc.DB_ID FROM ReactionlikeEvent_2_compartment rc JOIN memb m ON m.cmp = rc.compartment JOIN Event_2_species es ON es.DB_ID = rc.DB_ID JOIN DatabaseObject sp ON sp.DB_ID = es.species AND sp._displayName = 'Homo sapiens' GROUP BY rc.DB_ID HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT rc.compartment) >= 2) t;

questions.question: Human pathways (species includes Homo sapiens) carry summations, and those summations cite literature references, which in turn have authors. Which people are an author of the greatest number of distinct literature references reached that way? Give the display name of every person tied for the greatest number.

queries.sql: WITH tally AS (SELECT pa.author AS person, COUNT(DISTINCT sl.literatureReference) AS n FROM Pathway pw JOIN Event_2_species es ON es.DB_ID = pw.DB_ID JOIN DatabaseObject sp ON sp.DB_ID = es.species AND sp._displayName = 'Homo sapiens' JOIN Event_2_summation s ON s.DB_ID = pw.DB_ID JOIN Summation_2_literatureReference sl ON sl.DB_ID = s.summation JOIN Publication_2_author pa ON pa.DB_ID = sl.literatureReference GROUP BY pa.author) SELECT d._displayName FROM tally t JOIN DatabaseObject d ON d.DB_ID = t.person WHERE t.n = (SELECT MAX(n) FROM tally);

questions.question: Human reaction-like events (species includes Homo sapiens) may carry entity functional statuses, each of which carries functional statuses, each of which names a functional status type. Which functional status type is reached from the greatest number of distinct such events? Give its display name.

queries.sql: SELECT t._displayName FROM ReactionlikeEvent_2_entityFunctionalStatus refs JOIN Event_2_species es ON es.DB_ID = refs.DB_ID JOIN DatabaseObject sp ON sp.DB_ID = es.species AND sp._displayName = 'Homo sapiens' JOIN EntityFunctionalStatus_2_functionalStatus efs ON efs.DB_ID = refs.entityFunctionalStatus JOIN FunctionalStatus fs ON fs.DB_ID = efs.functionalStatus JOIN DatabaseObject t ON t.DB_ID = fs.functionalStatusType GROUP BY fs.functionalStatusType, t._displayName ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT refs.DB_ID) DESC LIMIT 1;

questions.question: Every modified residue (an instance of AbstractModifiedResidue or any of its subclasses) points at a reference sequence, and a reference sequence carries an ordered list of gene names. Taking only the rank-0 gene name of each reference sequence, which gene name has the greatest number of distinct modified residues pointing at reference sequences bearing it?

queries.sql: SELECT g.geneName FROM AbstractModifiedResidue amr JOIN ReferenceSequence_2_geneName g ON g.DB_ID = amr.referenceSequence AND g.geneName_rank = 0 GROUP BY g.geneName ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT amr.DB_ID) DESC LIMIT 1;

questions.question: How many distinct human reaction-like events (species includes Homo sapiens) have at least one orthologous event whose species includes Mus musculus, and no orthologous event whose species includes Rattus norvegicus?

queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT r.DB_ID) FROM ReactionlikeEvent r JOIN Event_2_species hs ON hs.DB_ID = r.DB_ID JOIN DatabaseObject h ON h.DB_ID = hs.species AND h._displayName = 'Homo sapiens' WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Event_2_orthologousEvent oe JOIN Event_2_species es ON es.DB_ID = oe.orthologousEvent JOIN DatabaseObject s ON s.DB_ID = es.species AND s._displayName = 'Mus musculus' WHERE oe.DB_ID = r.DB_ID) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Event_2_orthologousEvent oe JOIN Event_2_species es ON es.DB_ID = oe.orthologousEvent JOIN DatabaseObject s ON s.DB_ID = es.species AND s._displayName = 'Rattus norvegicus' WHERE oe.DB_ID = r.DB_ID);

questions.question: In the release with the highest release number, how many distinct pathways were recorded by the update tracker as having at least one action whose name begins with the letters 'add'?

queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT u.updatedInstance) FROM _UpdateTracker u JOIN _Release r ON r.DB_ID = u._release JOIN _UpdateTracker_2_action a ON a.DB_ID = u.DB_ID JOIN Pathway p ON p.DB_ID = u.updatedInstance WHERE r.releaseNumber = (SELECT MAX(releaseNumber) FROM _Release) AND a.action LIKE 'add%';

questions.question: Both catalyst activities and regulations may name an active unit. How many distinct entities serve as an active unit of at least one catalyst activity and also as an active unit of at least one regulation?

queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT activeUnit AS a FROM CatalystActivity_2_activeUnit) x JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT activeUnit AS a FROM Regulation_2_activeUnit) y ON y.a = x.a;

questions.question: For each human pathway (species includes Homo sapiens), look only at the reaction-like events it contains directly through hasEvent, and count the distinct compartments assigned across those events. What is the greatest such count over all human pathways?

queries.sql: SELECT MAX(c) FROM (SELECT he.DB_ID, COUNT(DISTINCT rc.compartment) AS c FROM Pathway_2_hasEvent he JOIN Event_2_species es ON es.DB_ID = he.DB_ID JOIN DatabaseObject sp ON sp.DB_ID = es.species AND sp._displayName = 'Homo sapiens' JOIN ReactionlikeEvent_2_compartment rc ON rc.DB_ID = he.hasEvent GROUP BY he.DB_ID) t;

questions.question: How many distinct publications are cited both as a literature reference of a summation of some human pathway and directly as a literature reference of some human reaction-like event? In both cases human means the event's species includes Homo sapiens.

queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT sl.literatureReference AS p FROM Pathway pw JOIN Event_2_species es ON es.DB_ID = pw.DB_ID JOIN DatabaseObject sp ON sp.DB_ID = es.species AND sp._displayName = 'Homo sapiens' JOIN Event_2_summation s ON s.DB_ID = pw.DB_ID JOIN Summation_2_literatureReference sl ON sl.DB_ID = s.summation) a JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT el.literatureReference AS p FROM ReactionlikeEvent r JOIN Event_2_species es ON es.DB_ID = r.DB_ID JOIN DatabaseObject sp ON sp.DB_ID = es.species AND sp._displayName = 'Homo sapiens' JOIN Event_2_literatureReference el ON el.DB_ID = r.DB_ID) b ON b.p = a.p;

questions.question: How many distinct human reaction-like events (species includes Homo sapiens) are annotated with at least one disease and also take as a direct input a drug, of any Drug subclass, whose reference therapeutic is marked approved?

queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT r.DB_ID) FROM ReactionlikeEvent r JOIN Event_2_species es ON es.DB_ID = r.DB_ID JOIN DatabaseObject sp ON sp.DB_ID = es.species AND sp._displayName = 'Homo sapiens' JOIN Event_2_disease ed ON ed.DB_ID = r.DB_ID JOIN ReactionlikeEvent_2_input i ON i.DB_ID = r.DB_ID JOIN Drug dr ON dr.DB_ID = i.input JOIN ReferenceTherapeutic rt ON rt.DB_ID = dr.referenceEntity AND rt.approved = 'TRUE';

questions.question: Consider human pathways (species includes Homo sapiens) that have been reviewed, where at least one author of a reviewing InstanceEdit is affiliated with an organisation whose name contains the word 'University'. How many of those pathways directly contain, through hasEvent, an event carrying a negative preceding event whose reason has the display name 'Futile Cycle'?

queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pw.DB_ID) FROM Pathway pw JOIN Event_2_species es ON es.DB_ID = pw.DB_ID JOIN DatabaseObject sp ON sp.DB_ID = es.species AND sp._displayName = 'Homo sapiens' JOIN Event_2_reviewed rv ON rv.DB_ID = pw.DB_ID JOIN InstanceEdit_2_author ia ON ia.DB_ID = rv.reviewed JOIN Person_2_affiliation pa ON pa.DB_ID = ia.author JOIN Affiliation_2_name an ON an.DB_ID = pa.affiliation AND an.name LIKE '%University%' JOIN Pathway_2_hasEvent he ON he.DB_ID = pw.DB_ID JOIN Event_2_negativePrecedingEvent ne ON ne.DB_ID = he.hasEvent JOIN NegativePrecedingEvent np ON np.DB_ID = ne.negativePrecedingEvent JOIN DatabaseObject rn ON rn.DB_ID = np.reason AND rn._displayName = 'Futile Cycle';

questions.question: Drugs that are a direct input to a human reaction-like event (species includes Homo sapiens) that is also annotated with at least one disease have reference therapeutics, and those carry cross-references. Which reference database is the source of the greatest number of distinct such cross-references? Give its display name.

queries.sql: SELECT d._displayName FROM ReactionlikeEvent_2_input i JOIN Drug dr ON dr.DB_ID = i.input JOIN ReferenceEntity_2_crossReference xr ON xr.DB_ID = dr.referenceEntity JOIN DatabaseIdentifier di ON di.DB_ID = xr.crossReference JOIN DatabaseObject d ON d.DB_ID = di.referenceDatabase JOIN Event_2_species es ON es.DB_ID = i.DB_ID JOIN DatabaseObject sp ON sp.DB_ID = es.species AND sp._displayName = 'Homo sapiens' JOIN Event_2_disease ed ON ed.DB_ID = i.DB_ID GROUP BY di.referenceDatabase, d._displayName ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT xr.crossReference) DESC LIMIT 1;

questions.question: The activity of a catalyst activity is a GO molecular function, which may carry EC numbers. Across human reaction-like events (species includes Homo sapiens), which EC number is reached from the greatest number of distinct such events?

queries.sql: SELECT ec.ecNumber FROM ReactionlikeEvent_2_catalystActivity rc JOIN CatalystActivity ca ON ca.DB_ID = rc.catalystActivity JOIN GO_MolecularFunction_2_ecNumber ec ON ec.DB_ID = ca.activity JOIN Event_2_species es ON es.DB_ID = rc.DB_ID JOIN DatabaseObject sp ON sp.DB_ID = es.species AND sp._displayName = 'Homo sapiens' GROUP BY ec.ecNumber ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT rc.DB_ID) DESC LIMIT 1;

questions.question: Replaced residues reference PSI-MOD terms. Which PSI-MOD term is referenced by the greatest number of distinct replaced residues? Give its display name.

queries.sql: SELECT d._displayName FROM ReplacedResidue_2_psiMod rp JOIN DatabaseObject d ON d.DB_ID = rp.psiMod GROUP BY rp.psiMod, d._displayName ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT rp.DB_ID) DESC LIMIT 1;

questions.question: Consider deletion records that name more than one distinct replacement instance. How many of those also name a deleted instance whose species includes Homo sapiens?

queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT r.DB_ID) FROM _Deleted_2_replacementInstances r JOIN _Deleted_2_deletedInstance di ON di.DB_ID = r.DB_ID JOIN _DeletedInstance_2_species ds ON ds.DB_ID = di.deletedInstance JOIN DatabaseObject sp ON sp.DB_ID = ds.species AND sp._displayName = 'Homo sapiens' WHERE r.DB_ID IN (SELECT DB_ID FROM _Deleted_2_replacementInstances GROUP BY DB_ID HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT replacementInstances) > 1);

questions.question: How many distinct polymers that have at least one repeated unit which is a Complex appear as a direct input to a human reaction-like event (species includes Homo sapiens)?

queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pr.DB_ID) FROM Polymer_2_repeatedUnit pr JOIN Complex cx ON cx.DB_ID = pr.repeatedUnit JOIN ReactionlikeEvent_2_input i ON i.input = pr.DB_ID JOIN Event_2_species es ON es.DB_ID = i.DB_ID JOIN DatabaseObject sp ON sp.DB_ID = es.species AND sp._displayName = 'Homo sapiens';

questions.question: Which protein marker is listed as a protein marker of the greatest number of distinct cells? Give its display name.

queries.sql: SELECT d._displayName FROM Cell_2_proteinMarker cm JOIN DatabaseObject d ON d.DB_ID = cm.proteinMarker GROUP BY cm.proteinMarker, d._displayName ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT cm.DB_ID) DESC LIMIT 1;

questions.question: Call a compartment 'membrane-derived' if it reaches the GO cellular component with accession 0016020 by following one or more instanceOf links. Now take every pathway lying at any depth below the pathway with stable identifier R-HSA-168256 in the hasEvent hierarchy. How many of those pathways were created by an InstanceEdit having an author affiliated with an organisation whose name contains 'University', and also directly contain, through hasEvent, a reaction-like event assigned at least one membrane-derived compartment?

queries.sql: WITH RECURSIVE sub AS (SELECT he.hasEvent AS ev FROM DatabaseObject d JOIN StableIdentifier s ON s.DB_ID = d.stableIdentifier JOIN Pathway_2_hasEvent he ON he.DB_ID = d.DB_ID WHERE s.identifier = 'R-HSA-168256' UNION SELECT he.hasEvent FROM sub JOIN Pathway_2_hasEvent he ON he.DB_ID = sub.ev), anc AS (SELECT DISTINCT rc.compartment AS node, rc.compartment AS root FROM ReactionlikeEvent_2_compartment rc UNION SELECT i.instanceOf, a.root FROM anc a JOIN GO_CellularComponent_2_instanceOf i ON i.DB_ID = a.node), memb AS (SELECT DISTINCT a.root AS cmp FROM anc a JOIN GO_CellularComponent g ON g.DB_ID = a.node AND g.accession = '0016020') SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.DB_ID) FROM sub JOIN Pathway p ON p.DB_ID = sub.ev JOIN DatabaseObject od ON od.DB_ID = p.DB_ID JOIN InstanceEdit_2_author ia ON ia.DB_ID = od.created JOIN Person_2_affiliation pa ON pa.DB_ID = ia.author JOIN Affiliation_2_name an ON an.DB_ID = pa.affiliation AND an.name LIKE '%University%' JOIN Pathway_2_hasEvent ch ON ch.DB_ID = p.DB_ID JOIN ReactionlikeEvent_2_compartment rc2 ON rc2.DB_ID = ch.hasEvent JOIN memb m ON m.cmp = rc2.compartment;
